note: Batch applied: CVE-2025-0725 and CVE-2025-14017 promoted from the proposal anchors (2). The four hold rows were relocated and applied individually via promote_candidate.py (see relocated_rows); the batch suppresses them, so their verdict stays hold here.

relocated_rows.reason: The proposed anchor came from the OSV range-boundary commit 172e54cda184 'tiny-curl: patch set applied on 8.4.0'; the advisory's GIT fixed event is 61275672b46d. That commit changes curl_easy_duphandle to call Curl_cookie_init() with NULL instead of data->cookies->filename, so a duplicate of a handle that never loaded a cookie file no longer keeps the literal 'none' filename. Both removed argument lines are present verbatim at the frozen anchor.

The fix deletes the wolfSSH backend, so its own diff no longer contains the vulnerable code; the static evidence is the frozen function. wssh_connect creates the wolfSSH context and session, sets the username, installs the auth callback and attaches the socket without installing any host-key check, so the backend cannot detect an impostor server.

ConnectionExists compares the handle credentials with the cached connection only under 'if defined(USE_NTLM)'; there is no equivalent check for Negotiate/SPNEGO, so a connection authenticated with ambient credentials for one user is reused for another handle's request. The fix rewrites this check around url_allow_sspi_empty_creds in newer code; the frozen 8.3.0 equivalent is the NTLM-only block at the anchor.

The proposed anchor was a libssh.c key-passwd hunk of the same commit. The advisory is about TLS client-key options missing from connection-reuse matching: Curl_ssl_config_matches compares version, verify flags, cert/CA files, blobs, ciphers, curves, CRL and pinned key but not key, key_type or key_passwd, so a connection created with one client key is reused after only those options change. The fix adds the key fields in newer code (match_ssl_primary_config).

rows.reason: Proposal anchored lib/cf-socket.c do_connect from 172e54cda184 'tiny-curl: patch set applied on 8.4.0' (an OSV range-boundary commit whose hunk is setsockopt casts). The advisory's own GIT fix is 61275672b46d, which passes NULL instead of data->cookies->filename in curl_easy_duphandle; relocate to lib/easy.c 928-930.

The fix drops OLD_ZLIB_SUPPORT and its hand-rolled gzip header parsing; the removed lines are the ZLIB_GZIP_HEADER cleanup in exit_zlib, present verbatim at the frozen anchor. The integer overflow the advisory describes lives in that manual header path.

Proposal anchored a brace change in the OS400 ccsid wrapper. The real fix b011e3fcfb06 deletes the wolfSSH backend entirely; the root cause at the frozen SHA is wssh_connect, which creates the client context and session and never installs host-key verification. Relocate to lib/vssh/wolfssh.c 389-415 and record evidence type source_review.

The removed line is ldap_set_option(NULL, LDAP_OPT_X_TLS_CACERTFILE, ldap_ca) - global TLS state shared by all threads. The fix calls ldap_init() first and sets the option on the per-connection server handle; the frozen line is present verbatim at ldap_do 443.

Proposal anchored a collateral Curl_attach_connection change in easy.c. The fix 7103a93b05bc changes url_allow_sspi_empty_creds/recent_conn_id logic, which does not exist in 8.3.0; the equivalent root cause is ConnectionExists, which compares credentials only for NTLM and reuses a Negotiate-authenticated connection without checking the requesting handle. Relocate to lib/url.c 1375-1395 with evidence type source_review.

Proposal anchored a libssh.c key-passwd hunk in the same commit. The advisory is about TLS client-certificate key options missing from connection-reuse matching; the frozen function Curl_ssl_config_matches omits key/key_type/key_passwd. Relocate to lib/vtls/vtls.c 161-190 with evidence type source_review.
